paragraphs.text: A proper image viewer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): zoom, pan, rotate, download, copy, open in the def
ault app and gallery browsing for in-chat images. 中文：DSH 聊天图片查看器，替代官方仅有「关闭」的预览。
# dsh-image-viewer-pro
[](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-image-viewer-pro/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://www.npmj
s.com/package/dsh-image-viewer-pro) [](LICENSE) [](#compatibility) [](#compatibility) [](https://git
hub.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
**A viewer for images inside a DeepSeek Harness conversation — not a close button with a picture beh
ind it.** Zoom, pan, rotate, a gallery, download, copy, a dialog you can drag, and open-with the app
s already on the machine, in one layer. Wheel, drag, and rotate update on the compositor once per fr
ame; the next image is decoded before it is shown, so a page turn does not flash at the wrong size.
It replaces the stock preview that only offers Close.
English | 中文
## See it
The pictures below are the real viewer, opened on photographs made for this page. The GIF plays on G
itHub; the MP4 link is the same take.
**Zoom and pan.** The wheel zooms around the pointer; dragging moves the picture.
zoom.mp4
**Rotate.** Each click turns 90°. The footer shows the angle.
rotate.mp4
**Gallery.** The side arrows and `←` / `→` move through the images in the conversation. The new pict
ure slides in from that side.
gallery.mp4
**Move the dialog.** Drag the title bar. The window stays inside the backdrop.
move.mp4
**Copy and download.** Copy writes a PNG and shows a toast; download saves the original.
actions.mp4
## Why
The stock image preview in DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only offers **Close**: no zoom, no pan, no rotate, no down
load, no switching between the images of one conversation. This plugin takes over content-image clic
ks in the **capture phase** and renders its own dialog — it does not depend on official slot contrac
ts, so it stays working when image slots change.
The viewer improves *looking*; it cannot make an image appear. See Getting images into the conversat
ion for prompt rules that get an agent to inline images in the first place.
## Features
- **Zoom** — wheel zooms around the pointer. One mouse notch is about 12% and eases in over a few fr
ames; trackpad ticks stay continuous. The footer shows `− [percent] +` and the percentage is editabl
e (Enter applies, Esc reverts). A tap on ± matches one notch; holding ± zooms continuously (about on

e doubling every 0.7s). Keyboard `+` / `-` stays a 25% step. The scale stays within 5%–4000%.
- **Pa

n** — drag the canvas; double-click toggles fit ↔ actual size.
- **Footer** — the controls sit in th

ree groups separated by hairlines: zoom, fit / 1:1, and rotate.
- **Move the dialog** — drag its tit
le bar; the dialog stays inside the backdrop (never over the desktop's native title/menu bar) and is

pulled back into bounds when the window is resized.
- **Header info** — the title row shows `width
× height | format | file size` with values only; the format is uppercase (JPG/PNG/SVG/BMP/WEBP…) and

the size switches between B, KB and MB (one decimal for KB/MB).
- **Rotate** — counterclockwise on

the left, clockwise on the right, 90° per click, with the current angle centered between them.
- **D

ownload original** — with progress; saves to the system downloads folder.
- **Copy image** — writes

a PNG to the clipboard.
- **Gallery** — browse the other images in the same conversation with the ro
und side arrows or `←` / `→`; shows `current / total`. The incoming picture pushes in from the side
you asked for and the previous one leaves the other way, about 420ms on the same curve as the dialog

open. A second step settles the one already playing. Reduced motion still cuts straight across.
- *
*Open** — a local file uses a split button. The main face shows the default app's icon and opens the
file with that app; the menu lists every associated app reported by `session.workspacePathApplicati
ons` (the default is marked) and ends with "Show file location". A remote `http(s)` image stays a ne
w-tab button. `blob:` and `data:` sources hide it. Opening and revealing both go through the Host's

`session.openWorkspacePath`.
[该节后续省略]
## What it takes over
| Image | Viewer |

| Markdown images in message text (`![](...)`, http(s) or the Host file route) | ✅ |
| Images attach

ed to user and assistant messages (DSH renders them as `blob:` URLs) | ✅ |
| Tool-result images such

as `read_image` (same attachment channel) | ✅ |
| Icons, avatars and status images below 48px | ❌ s

tay native |
| Images inside the plugin's own dialog (recursion guard) | ❌ |
Only the click behaviour is intercepted: message content is not modified, no session data is written
, and the page returns to normal after closing the dialog.
## Getting images into the conversation
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
- Verified on **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`** (Web GUI and desktop, both Web renderers) and **DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`*

0`, checked on install and profile boot.
- Uses the Host `remote` / `remote.session` services to ope
n or reveal a local file. When those services are unavailable the action degrades to a notice and ev
erything else keeps working.
## Privacy

- No third-party requests, no access to model credentials.
- Download / copy only touch the current

image. Opening or revealing a local file goes through DSH's Host-side capability.
- Interception onl
y affects clicks: no message content is injected and no session record is modified.
## Known limitations

- Icons, avatars and status images below 48px stay native (see the coverage table above).
- Remote c
ross-origin images are displayed by the browser directly; when their server does not allow CORS, dow

nload falls back to opening the image in a new tab and copy falls back to copying its URL.
- Icons a

re inline 16px SVG; the `1:1` glyph is dense at that size.
- Targets the DSH Web GUI and desktop cli

ent (same Web renderer).
- The gallery counts images currently rendered in the conversation scrollpo
rt; in extreme virtual-scrolling cases only mounted images can be browsed.
